name: Diversity Boost legacy node (step-0 low-pass plus random DCT field)
plain: Acts only at the first step. The post-CFG x0 is moved to raw VAE latent space and low-passed with an order-6 Butterworth mask whose DC term is set to dc_preserve (0 by default, so each channel's mean is removed). It is then multiplied by a random 4×4 DCT spatial field (pink, white or blue weighting, DC coefficient zero), normalized to unit std, scaled by strength and clamped to [0.1, 1 + clamp]. Surprises: the field comes from torch.randn with no seeded generator, so it changes between runs regardless of the seed, and the node's fingerprint is the clock, so it re-runs every queue. This is a different algorithm from the V3 node in the existing diversity-boost entry.
math:
Step 0 only (σ matched in sample_sigmas). r = process_out(x̂).
F = rfft2(r)·A, A(f) = 1/√(1 + ρ¹²), ρ = √((f_y·H/n)² + (f_x·W/n)²), A(0) = dc_preserve; r_b = irfft2(F).
c ~ N(0, I) in 16 dims (unseeded), c₀ = 0, c ← c·w_noise; φ = Σₖ cₖ·Bₖ (orthonormal 4×4 DCT-II basis); φ ← strength·φ/std(φ).
r′ = r_b·clamp(1 + φ, 0.1, 1 + clamp); optional r′ ← r′·RMS(r)/RMS(r′) per channel; x̂ ← process_in(r′).

props.params: strength=0.5, clamp=1.0, noise_type=pink, n_periods=2, dc_preserve=0, energy_compensate=false
